verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. It runs models on-device (iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps) and serves them on localhost (127.0.0.1). That architecture implies user prompts never reach a vendor that could train on them, but the evidence never states this explicitly. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-use policy, a no-telemetry statement, and independent verification that no data leaves the device.
